name: SkillEvaluator
description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills and plugins with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.
one_liner: A quality-control checker that tests whether an AI agent 'skill' or plugin actually works and is safe before you install or ship it.
buyer: A company publishing AI agent skills/plugins who needs to prove quality and security to enterprise buyers before they'll adopt it.
business_use_cases: A skill marketplace runs every submitted skill through this before listing it, as a trust signal to buyers.
An enterprise AI platform team gates internal skill merges in CI so a bad skill can't reach production agents.
A consultancy offers paid 'skill audits' for companies building on Claude/agent plugins, using this as the engine.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid third-party skill certification/audits for marketplaces and enterprises, using this as the backend.

steal_this: Set up a free public 'skill health check' webpage built on this tool to attract skill authors, then upsell deeper paid audits.
